description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two different models, T5-small and T5-large, across various turn IDs in a continual dialogue state tracking experiment. The horizontal axis represents the turn ID, ranging from 0 to 26, while the vertical axis indicates the average JGA score, ranging from 0 to 1. The T5-small model is represented by orange bars, and the T5-large model by gray bars. The T5-small model generally has higher average JGA scores compared to the T5-large model, with the scores for T5-small starting at approximately 0.95 and gradually decreasing to around 0.3, while the T5-large model starts at around 0.9 and decreases to about 0.2.
